settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.row_content: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Standard shipping typically takes 5-10 business days, depending on your location.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.row_content: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can also check your order status on our Track Your Order page.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.row_content: We offer a 30-day return policy on all unused items in their original packaging. Contact us to start a return.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: We accept all major credit cards, as well as other secure payment methods available at checkout.

settings.heading: Do you ship internationally?
settings.row_content: Currently we ship within the regions shown at checkout. If your country isn't listed, please contact us and we'll do our best to help.

settings.heading: How do I get in touch with support?
settings.row_content: Visit our Contact Us page and send us a message — we typically respond within 24 hours on business days.
